rationale: Early-2022 articles used coarse half-star/integer categories and fine decimal calculations in parallel. Treating every displayed 4.0/4.5/5.0 as a precise 0.1-star point creates false precision.

key_evidence.evidence: 今天大盘整体下跌，还是在4.5星级。如果细一些计算，目前算是4.8了。
key_evidence.implication: The coarse label 4.5-star and fine decimal 4.8 can simultaneously describe the same day.

key_evidence.evidence: 今天大盘上涨，走出了5星级，现在算是4.9星级。
key_evidence.implication: 5-star was a coarse category boundary while 4.9 was the fine decimal state.

key_evidence.evidence: Daily article evidence consistently reports 0.1-star values such as 4.9, 4.8, 4.7, 4.6 and 4.5.
key_evidence.implication: June 2022 onward is suitable for ordinary fine 0.1-star treatment.

proposed_semantics.condition: date <= 2022-05-30 AND status == exact AND displayed star is on the 0.5 grid
explicit fine decimal such as 4.8/4.9/5.1, including before 2022-05-31

safeguards: Do not replace coarse labels with invented 4.1/4.2/4.3/4.4 decimals.
Preserve original article wording and verified star field as evidence.
Add granularity as separate metadata in a versioned Target v2 rather than overwriting the frozen v1 used for the completed prospective experiment.
Any new model based on Target v2 requires a new clean confirmation window strictly after the data used to define this policy.
